items.q: A man by the name of Rudy Vallee was an ardent fan of Louis Armstrong’s... Rudy Vallee said I want Louis Armstrong to replace me for two months.

ctx.x: I was going to ask. © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-

In 1937 Louis Armstrong was the first man of color to have a coast to coast radio show. A man by the name of Rudy Vallee was an ardent fan of Louis Armstrong’s and when his boss the Fleishman’s Yeast Hour, the president of the Fleishman Company asked him for a replacement, Rudy Vallee said I want Louis Armstrong to replace me for two months. And of course they wouldn’t hear of it. So he said, “Well I will break my contact or I want to hire Louis and I want to own the shows.” Those radio shows were done and they…
